idea: Marketplace of models, memos and deck templates for analysts
pain: Everyone rebuilds the same models and memo structures from scratch
v1: Twenty templates sold as a pack
channel: Her analyst network plus public content
verdict: Good leverage, terrible arithmetic, and the underlying artefacts are being commoditised by AI.

why.distribution: Her network would buy a few; volume requires an audience she lacks.
why.demand: Inferred; templates circulate free within the industry.
why.fmf: Her templates would genuinely be good and she has authority to sell them.
why.defensibility: Templates are shared instantly and AI generates passable ones on demand.
why.tailwind: Actively adverse - this is precisely what generative models now produce free.
why.ceiling: £350 x 570 packs = £200k, an impossible volume for a commoditising product.

ceiling_arithmetic: £350 x 570 packs = £200k. Selling 570 template packs requires mass distribution she does not have, for artefacts an LLM now generates free. Realistic: 50-100 = £17-35k.
kills: The product is being given away by the technology she is expert in. Defensibility 1, tailwind 1.
test: Offer the pack at £350 to twenty analysts.
test_fail: They ask her to just send it - the likely response.
